items.t: **[[management-recon|The recon]]** (171 URLs) — two businesses share the word agency: the licensed booker at 10 to 15 percent and the [[ofm|OFM]] operations vendor at 20 to 50 percent or more. Fanvue is the only platform with a real agency structure. Creator-first is the documented origin of the lane (Jameson 2000 · Angel 2002 · Reid's [[ash|A.S.H.]] 2021 · Autumn's Angels · Bop House 2024). Reputation, not capital, is the barrier. [[fla-468|Florida ch. 468]] goes live the moment a second human is booked.

**[[management-voices|The voices]]** (22) — nobody credible started with a roster; they started with one relationship. Creator-first operators sell the thing they built for themselves first. The commission number is the ethics map: 10 to 15 licensed · 5 to 15 the creators' own standard · 25 to 70 in OFM reality. Account control is the line. Houses break on control, not money.

**[[natasha-teen|Natasha Teen]]** — she did build it. Natasha Teen Films opened its studio account on 2020-11-17 ("agencia / modelos y producción audiovisual"), runs a 14-model roster on AnalVids and an XVideos channel at 166K subscribers. A co-fronted studio-plus-agency: her partner Lancelot runs production, her stated job is training the new talent. No pricing, split or earnings on record. Verdict: yes on the network, partial on the agency shape.

**Five more cases landed tonight, TTP headers on** — Ellexxaurus (the face as the top tier; X 1.0M rebuilt after account loss) · Hungryanuz (the ban-to-hub rebuild after a 2021 OnlyFans ban; unlockd.me = Fans Media Ltd, UK) · Gape Game (not a person: Kozzy's keyword-named second Pornhub channel; durable, not S++ by rank) · PeggingOnlyOfficial (own the category noun, two shelves, one owner; single operator) · plus Natasha Teen above. TTP written into the eight pre-existing files at 16:36. Rebel Rhyder included.

**The process died mid-wave at about 18:30** — babylite and Bilbuana had landed (rows applied from the files); Bad Dragon Slayer · BottomToys · Michael Vegas · Tweetney · Coco Lovecock never did. Papi: "don't restart anything." **15 case files on disk**, every header TTP.

At about 16:00 a second session read the three files as dead and relaunched duplicates. The original session landed them between 16:07 and 16:15. Duplicates stood down; BOLO row and session note corrected. Lesson banked: check the other sessions before declaring a file dead.
